provenance_registry: SILAGEGUARD AI V2.1 Research Literature Registry
purpose: Documents external peer-reviewed literature used to define agronomic boundaries and safety rules.

external_sources.citation: Kung, L., Shaver, R. D., Grant, R. J., & Schmidt, R. J. (2018). Silage review: Interpretation of chemical, microbial, and organoleptic components of silages. Journal of Dairy Science, 101(5), 4020-4033.
external_sources.how_utilized_in_project: Supplied reference threshold intervals for optimal lactic preservation (pH 3.8-4.2), clostridial warning boundaries (pH > 5.0), and severe spoilage overrides (pH > 6.0).

external_sources.citation: Borreani, G., Tabacco, E., Schmidt, R. J., Holmes, B. J., & Muck, R. E. (2018). Silage review: Factors affecting dry matter and quality losses in silages. Journal of Dairy Science, 101(5), 3952-3979.
external_sources.how_utilized_in_project: Supplied scientific basis for aerobic runaway heat thresholds (delta_T > 3.0°C caution, delta_T > 10.0°C critical override).

external_sources.citation: Muck, R. E., Nadeau, E. M., McAllister, T. A., Contreras-Govea, F. E., Santos, M. C., & Kung, L. (2018). Silage review: Recent advances and future uses of silage additives. Journal of Dairy Science, 101(5), 3980-4000.
external_sources.how_utilized_in_project: Informed advisory logic regarding homolactic vs heterolactic fermentation.

clarification_statement: The project does NOT possess raw physical telemetry CSVs from external public universities. The literature references represent agronomic meta-analysis benchmarks from which our synthetic ranges and safety rule thresholds were derived.
